debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d f-a-l-s-e c-a-p-t-i-v-e b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g l-o-g-s w-i-t-h d-a-t-e s a-n-d p-a-r-e-n-t i-d-s t-o c-l-a-i-m o-u-t-b-r-e-e-d s-t-o-c-k, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-p-r-e-a-d-s-h-e-e-t e-d-i-t t-i-m-e-s t-a-m-p-s, w-h-i-l-e b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g o-r-i-g-i-n v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k-s
2) the a-c-t-o-r s-y-n-t-h-e-s-i-z-e-d o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p h-i-s-t-o-r-y d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s u-s-i-n-g o-l-d r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r n-a-m-e-s a-n-d l-o-g-i-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a i-p a-t-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n-s, w-h-i-l-e b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g c-o-w-n-e-r a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p-s
3) the a-c-t-o-r c-l-o-n-e-d p-e-r-m-i-t f-o-r-m-a-t-s w-i-t-h e-x-p-i-r-e-d s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e n-u-m-b-e-r-s t-o m-i-m-i-c i-s-s-u-e-d a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g r-e-u-s-e-d c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-e d-e-s-i-g-n s, w-h-i-l-e b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-i-n-g a-g-e-n-c-y v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n
4) the a-c-t-o-r p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s d-e-s-c-r-i-b-i-n-g w-i-l-d-t-a-k-e-n s-p-e-c-i-m-e-n-s a-s b-r-e-e-d s-t-o-c-k u-s-i-n-g s-t-o-l-e-n p-h-o-t-o-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g m-a-r-k-e-t-p-l-a-c-e p-o-s-t t-r-a-c-e-s a-n-d i-p l-o-g-s, w-h-i-l-e b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g l-i-s-t-i-n-g m-o-d-e-r-a-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w
5) the a-c-t-o-r m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-e-d t-a-g g-i-v-i-n-g p-h-o-t-o-s w-i-t-h i-m-a-g-e e-d-i-t-i-n-g t-o a-l-t-e-r t-a-g d-a-t-a a-p-p-e-a-r-a-n-c-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g e-d-i-t-e-d i-m-a-g-e f-i-l-e-s w-i-t-h m-o-d-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n t-i-m-e-s t-a-m-p-s, w-h-i-l-e b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-a-g g-i-v-e-r p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
